subject: AWS handshake: AcroHealth intro + mutual action plan and cadence
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Goldstein <sara@acrohealth.com>, Ben Atwood <ben.atwood@amazon.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS handshake: AcroHealth intro + mutual action plan and cadence

Hi Sara / Ben —

Thanks for taking time to connect today. As discussed on our quick call, AcroHealth is evaluating incremental AI-powered triage for intake workflows and would like to explore a co-sell path with AWS. I want to pull together a short mutual action plan and propose an initial cadence so we can move from discovery -> joint PoC -> pilots.

Proposed next steps (high level):
- 1 week: intro call with technical leads to scope data access & latency SLOs
- 2 weeks: share MAP draft + Redwood 2pp solution brief (attached)
- 3–6 weeks: joint PoC runbook + AWS support alignment

Could you please confirm who from AcroHealth should be on the discovery call (technical + security)? Also tagging Ben from AWS to help with co-sell registration guidance and any partner playbook items we should prep.

Attached: AcroHealth-MAP-v1.pdf (draft), Redwood-Solution-Brief-2pp.pdf

Thanks — I can host an initial 30-min intro Wed or Thu afternoon PT.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Head of Field GTM, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Goldstein <sara@acrohealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Atwood <ben.atwood@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS handshake: AcroHealth intro + mutual action plan and cadence

HI Mina —

Thanks for the clear plan and the attachments. AcroHealth is interested — I will join the discovery call. Please include the following from our side:
- Dev lead: Marco Alvarez (marco.alvarez@acrohealth.com) — will own integration
- Security: Priya Shah (priya.shah@acrohealth.com) — needs a short questionnaire and SOC2 specifics

We prefer Thu 17 Jun 2026 at 2:00pm PT for the intro call. If that works for everyone, please send an invite. Also, can you add the short security checklist items we need to review ahead of time?

Quick Q: for the PoC, do you have a recommended data-retention default and KV-cache approach for PHI-like pseudo-production data? We can start with synthetic/extracted samples but want to align guardrails early.

Cheers,
Sara Goldstein
Director of Product
AcroHealth

From: Ben Atwood <ben.atwood@amazon.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Sara Goldstein <sara@acrohealth.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS handshake: AcroHealth intro + mutual action plan and cadence

Thanks Mina / Sara — happy to join Thu. I can also help with the AWS Partner Network (APN) registration checklist and co-sell registration once you have a MAP draft. Sharing our joint-account MAP template here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aB2cMAPTemplate — we usually capture milestones, success metrics, escalation contacts, and a procurement runway.

Sara — for PHI-ish datasets we recommend:
- Start with de-identified synthetic samples for PoC
- Retention: keep ephemeral caches (KV/prefix) for <= 24 hours by default during PoC; production choices depend on your compliance posture and whether you're on Dedicated/private deployment
- If PHI is a hard requirement, we can route traffic to a Private deployment with customer-managed KMS/HSM and provide an evidence package for our SOC2 controls

I'll be on the Thu 17 Jun 2026 14:00 PT call. If you want, I can run a 10-min primer on APN registration steps at the end of our call.

Ben Atwood
Partner Manager, AWS Marketplace & Partners
ben.atwood@amazon.com | +1 206-555-0199

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Goldstein <sara@acrohealth.com>, Ben Atwood <ben.atwood@amazon.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS handshake: AcroHealth intro + mutual action plan and cadence

Thanks all — great call today. Notes + immediate actions below (pulled from meeting recording).

Meeting highlights:
- AcroHealth confirmed Marco (dev) + Priya (security) as primary technical and compliance contacts
- Agreed PoC scope: intake triage for three clinics (~2k daily records) with latency target < 200ms p95 for inference
- AWS to assist with co-sell registration steps and outreach to field sales after MAP is signed

Action items (owners / due):
- Mina: finalize MAP v1 (I added Ben's template items) and share by EOD Mon 22 Jun 2026 — attachment: AcroHealth-MAP-v1.pdf (updated)
- Karthik: own the demo and PoC runbook; prepare a 2-slide solution brief (template attached) before Wed 24 Jun 2026
- Marco (AcroHealth): share synthetic sample and schema by Mon 22 Jun 2026
- Priya (AcroHealth): send security questionnaire answers and any redlines by Fri 26 Jun 2026

Notes on security: we agreed on ephemeral KV caches for PoC and to explore Private deployment if production requires PHI retention. Karthik, please include default cache TTL and tokenization approach in the runbook.

Attachments referenced: Redwood-Solution-Brief-2pp.pdf (stub), AcroHealth-MAP-v1.pdf (updated stub)

Will schedule the weekly 30-min cadence starting Tue 23 Jun 2026 at 10:00am PT unless objections.

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0177
